mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with disulfiram's metabolic effects can potentiate CNS depression and disulfiram's inhibition of dopamine β-hydroxylase may further impair catecholamine metabolism, increasing risk of hypertensive crisis and psychotic episodes.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use only with careful monitoring and dose adjustment; consider alternative alcohol deterrent; monitor blood pressure and psychiatric symptoms closely if combination is necessary.
